obligations.condition: Create a dedicated account with a generated password. Check returned same-account tokens, positive-integer expiry and the separate 3600-second expectation. Verify ownership by marker/email and independent UID lookup, then persist/reread UID before mutation.
Prove the original password authenticates as the same UID and obtain a fresh ID token for the password change.
Use the baseline signin ID token to set a distinct password with returnSecureToken=true. Check same UID/email, both token fields and expiry.
Use the update response ID token and compare selected account fields with pre-change lookup.
Under recorded improved email privacy, original-password signin must return HTTP400 INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS. An arbitrary error, disabled-account error or throttling is not equivalent.
After old-password rejection, use the update ID token to compare selected fields with the pre-rejection lookup, preserving missing/null/type distinctions.
The replacement password authenticates as the original UID/email and returns usable credentials.
Use the new-password signin ID token and compare selected fields to the original account.
Use the password update response refresh token with grant_type=refresh_token. Check same UID, token fields, bearer type and expiry.
Use the refreshed ID token and compare selected fields to the original account.
Delete the dedicated account using the refreshed end-user ID token after verified UID ownership confirmation.
Exact UID and email Admin selectors both confirm account absence. Unknown UID remains unresolved; recovered identity is persisted before any cleanup deletion.

limitations: No human approval. Twelve bounded end-user email/password REST cases, no tenant, strict owned local artifact and recorded production configuration.

Official REST snapshot reuses the earlier immutable acquisition; raw/body hashes and original fetchedAt are preserved. Selected sections reviewed 2026-09-10. Policy and privacy references acquired separately for this slice.

Selected-state comparisons cover localId, email, emailVerified, displayName, photoUrl and disabled. No password hash, passwordUpdatedAt, validSince, lastLoginAt or provider synchronization comparison.

Five token-returning cases check positive-integer expiry and 3600 seconds separately. Actual immediate use is checked for change-password ID/refresh tokens and new-password login ID token; not every returned token is independently exercised.
No old-token revocation timing, elapsed-expiry enforcement, recent-login time boundary, weak-password/policy boundary, password reset, SDK, MFA, Rules or public npm/full Auth claim.

Normal verified cleanup does not prove injected network-loss or forced-termination recovery. Raw responses and credentials are not published; public booleans are recorder testimony, not independent JWT verification.

preconditions.condition: Require exact client schemaVersion 1, enforcementState ENFORCE, minPasswordLength 6 and maxPasswordLength 4096; admin config must omit passwordPolicyConfig. This explicit readback is not inferred OFF. Distinct 47-character generated passwords have uppercase/lowercase/numeric/non-alphanumeric characters; no configuration is changed.
